exposure: Serum high molecular weight adiponectin (HMWA) level
outcome: Occurrence of eclampsia during subsequent pregnancy
cohort: 30 patients with primary PIH and 60 patients without primary PIH.
finding: Lower serum HMWA levels in patients with primary PIH are associated with increased severity of PIH, poorer pregnancy outcomes, and a higher risk of eclampsia in subsequent pregnancies.
gest_age: Lower gestational age in the observation group (primary PIH) compared to the control group
birth_weight: Lower neonatal weight in the observation group (primary PIH) compared to the control group
